name: Oshiba Hagane
source:
A young man thought to be one of the Masters.

His particulars, including his personality, past and even the identity of his guardian angels or demons are all treated as major unknowns. He wields a nodachi and is trained in the Shinto Hakusan fencing style.

...No further information about him is known at present.

[Source: [url=http://www.mangagamer.org/tokyobabel/]MangaGamer[/url]]
